text: Early in a busy opening, the service crew met a mislaid note and paused long enough to sort the desk flow before it spread confusion. Companion Animal Travel Desk Incident Report. The note had been left in a shared work tray, and it briefly delayed matching a booking file with the correct travel folder. The senior coordinator checked the open cases, confirmed which traveler record needed attention, and had the desk team compare the intake details against the carrier and routing notes. No safety issue arose, but the mix-up could have led to a slow handoff if it had not been caught at once. The team then updated the record, returned the note to the proper file, and briefed the next staff member so the same error would not repeat. Clear guidance was given to the traveler, and the pet care plan stayed intact throughout. Follow-up review showed the desk was otherwise orderly, with only the usual rush at opening and no further interruptions. The senior coordinator asked for a quick check of tray labels and filing habits, and the team agreed to keep the process tight. The matter was closed after the correction was confirmed.
